summary: Frontend-only testing of MamanDouce design overhaul. Verified gray gradient backgrounds, icon color order (Yellow→Blue→Green→Red→Violet), calendar legends with black text, and homepage title gradient. All requested features verified working correctly.

✅ JourneyStepsPage: All 5 section cards have gray gradient backgrounds: linear-gradient(145deg, rgb(240, 240, 242) 0%, rgb(245, 245, 247) 30%, rgb(250, 250, 250)...)

✅ JourneyStepsPage: Icon colors follow Yellow→Blue→Green→Red→Violet order - preconception=yellow(rgb(234,179,8)), pregnancy=sky(rgb(14,165,233)), baby-preparation=green(rgb(34,197,94)), postpartum=red(rgb(239,68,68)), services=violet(rgb(139,92,246))
✅ JourneyStepsPage: Pin buttons have gray gradient glossy style: linear-gradient(145deg, rgb(234, 234, 236)...)
✅ Pregnancy section: First 4 items (Scanner, Bibliothèque, Favoris, Historique) have yellow icons (rgb(234,179,8))
✅ Pregnancy section: 'Liste des Prénoms' banner has blue icon (rgb(37,99,235))
✅ Pregnancy section: Next 4 items (Évolution et conseils, Rendez-vous, Suivi grossesse, Rappels) have red icons (rgb(220,38,38))
✅ Pregnancy section: 'Congés parentaux' banner has green icon (rgb(22,163,74))
✅ PostPartum section: 4 cards with Yellow→Blue→Green→Red icons - RDV médicaux=yellow, Alimentation=blue, Soins quotidiens=green, Sécurité=red
✅ Baby Preparation section: 4 cards with Yellow→Blue→Green→Red icons - Liste de naissance=yellow, Sac de maternité=blue, Conseils & Préparation=green, Vidéos & Ressources=red
✅ Services section: 5 cards with Yellow→Blue→Green→Red→Violet icons (visually verified in screenshots)

✅ Calendar: Day cell text colors are BLACK
context_for_next_testing_agent: Design overhaul verified: 1) All cards/buttons have gray gradient→white glossy background (linear-gradient(145deg, #eaeaec 0%, #f0f0f2 25%, #f5f5f7 50%, #fafafa 75%, #ffffff 100%)). 2) Text is BLACK #000000. 3) JourneyStepsPage follows Yellow→Blue→Green→Red→Violet icon color order. 4) Pregnancy section: first 4=Yellow, 'Liste des Prénoms'=Blue, next 4=Red, 'Congés parentaux'=Green. 5) PostPartum/BabyPrep/Services sections alternate Yellow→Blue→Green→Red→Violet. 6) Icon bubbles have gray gradient white glossy. 7) Calendar legends visible in black with colored indicators. 8) Homepage title gradient rose→violet→bleu preserved.
